pages.main_text_excerpt:
This is KONGSBERG
KONGSBERG protects people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space. Through innovation, collaboration and determination, we develop technologies and solutions to serve the defence, security and surveillance markets.
About us
We combine military and civilian expertise to drive rapid innovation for defence, research, and commercial applications.
Our defence and security solutions include strike missiles, remote weapon stations, air defence systems, command and control systems and digital remote towers for customers worldwide. Our solutions help strengthen countries' security and defence capabilities.
KONGSBERG also serves the ocean space with technology – from sensors to autonomous systems – to ensure sustainable management of marine resources, monitor climate change and critical infrastructure, and safeguard national security.
KONGSBERG delivers to every part of the space value chain – from launch services and production of small satellites to downloading and managing satellite data.
The company was founded in 1814 in the town of Kongsberg, Norway. Today, we are more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is headquartered in Norway and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The Norwegian government controls about 50.01 percent of the shares in KONGSBERG.
Through innovation and state-of-the-art industrial production, we create jobs and value for our suppliers, partners, customers and owners.
We protect people and planet by innovating technology today, for a better tomorrow.
Three strong divisions
KONGSBERG consists of three divisions:
- Defence Systems
- Missiles & Aerostructures
- Discovery
Defence Systems
This division focuses on land systems, air and coastal defence, naval systems and advanced defence solutions. It includes core defence capabilities such as integrated defence systems, weapon platforms and advanced operational solutions. The division carries significant responsibility for deliveries within highly regulated defence environments and plays a central role in meeting growing demand from NATO and allied markets.
Missiles & Aerostructures
This division brings together missile programmes, aerostructures and maintenance capabilities. It includes both subsonic and supersonic missile programmes, aerostructures production and maintenance of airborne platforms. It also has a dedicated Emerging Business unit to support innovation and new growth areas. The division consolidates advanced manufacturing and programme execution under one structure, strengthening end-to-end accountability across complex value chains.
Discovery
This division integrates the former business area Kongsberg Discovery with Space and Surveillance activities. It combines capabilities in underwater technology, sensors, satellite systems and surveillance, creating a cohesive environment for dual-use and cross-domain innovation. Most civilian-oriented activities are gathered within this division. This allows these businesses to operate with the flexibility required to compete in international civilian markets, without being subject to defence-specific rules and processes that apply elsewhere in the company. At the same time, the division benefits from close collaboration with defence and space activities, strengthening technology development across domains.
Ownership structure
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and is subject to Norwegian securities legislation and stock exchange regulations. The Norwegian state owns 50.004 per cent of the shares in the company.
More about the company
Sustainability and corporate social responsibility
Sustainability and corporate social responsibility are important for KONGSBERG and are an integral part of our strategy. We shall conduct our business in a sustainable and accountable manner, and we must carry out our corporate social responsibility in accordance with the applicable expectations of society. This gives KONGSBERG the necessary ‘licence to operate’ in order to execute our business.
The UN has defined 17 sustainability development goals the world should reach by 2030. Several of these goals can only be achieved through innovation and the sensible application of technology. To KONGSBERG, this involves business opportunities in several markets viewed in the light of our broad technology and skills platform.
KONGSBERG has acceded to the UN Global Compact initiative. We support and respect international human and employee rights such as the UN’s Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, ILO Core Conventions and the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises. KONGSBERG uses the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines for the voluntary reporting of sustainable development.

pages.title: KONGSBERG: protecting people and planet – from deep sea to space - KONGSBERG - an international technology group
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Following the demerger and separate listing of Kongsberg Maritime, Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (‘KONGSBERG’) is now dedicated to developing the technology and solutions required to protect people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space.
“The decision to separate the two companies was taken with an eye on future market opportunities. To create more value in a rapidly changing world, where security and sustainability are expected to dominate in the coming decades,” said Eivind Reiten, Chair of the Board of KONGSBERG Gruppen ASA.
“KONGSBERG will be better positioned to navigate and grasp opportunities in its markets with a Board of Directors and executive leadership that are solely focused on defence, security and related matters,” said Reiten.
                        
I am proud to lead KONGSBERG into the future, together with more than 7,500 highly skilled and motivated colleagues. Our mission – to protect people and planet – has never been more appropriate and right.
This is why we exist – and why I believe we are positioned to continue to grow.
Eirik Lie, President and Chief Executive Officer of KONGSBERG.
Lie succeeds Geir Håøy, who led KONGSBERG as President and CEO from 2016 till 2026.
“Together, we combine a unique blend of military and civilian expertise to drive rapid innovation for defence, research, and commercial applications. Through innovation and state-of-the-art industrial production, we will continue to create jobs and value for our suppliers, partners, customers and owners,” he added.
A focused technology company
KONGSBERG’s defence and security solutions include strike missiles NSM and JSM, PROTECTOR remote weapon stations and Counter-UAS system, the NASAMS air defence system for customers worldwide. The company also serves the ocean space with advanced technology – from sensors to autonomous systems, including the HUGIN autonomous underwater vehicle – to ensure sustainable management of marine resources, monitor climate change and critical infrastructure, and safeguard national security. KONGSBERG delivers to the whole space value chain – from launch services and production of small satellites to downloading and managing satellite data.
KONGSBERG has three strong divisions: Missiles and Aerostructures, Discovery and Defence Systems.
The company was founded in 1814 in the town of Kongsberg, Norway. Today, KONGSBERG has more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is headquartered in Norway and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.

pages.title: Shape the future with us - KONGSBERG - an international technology group
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Shape the future with us
Join KONGSBERG and be part of a leading technology company developing advanced solutions for defence, security, oceans, space and critical infrastructure. Across our organisation, we combine deep domain expertise with innovation and collaboration to create technology that protects people, supports society and strengthens national capabilities.
Explore our vision and uncover your career potential
Our people are at the centre of everything we do. Bringing together diverse skills, perspectives and experience, we work across disciplines to solve complex challenges and deliver high-performance solutions in demanding environments. This is where technology, purpose and teamwork come together.
At KONGSBERG, you will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects with real-world impact, from next-generation defence systems and underwater technology to space and digital solutions. Explore your opportunities and build your future with KONGSBERG.
Do you have questions about applying for a job with us? Find the answers here.
Considering a career at KONGSBERG? We’ve gathered answers to the most frequently asked questions about the application process, career opportunities, work environment, and what to expect as an employee. This is a great starting point for your journey towards a future with us.
- We offer a diverse range of roles across various disciplines, reflecting its commitment to innovation and excellence.. Opportunities are available in areas such as systems engineering, project management, mechanical and electrical engineering, software development, and more.
- We support professional growth and development through a variety of initiatives that foster continuous learning, skill enhancement, and career progression. We ensure that employees have ample opportunities to grow in their careers while staying at the forefront of technological and industry advancements.
- KONGSBERG is deeply committed to sustainability, integrating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles into its core operations. This commitment is reflected in several key areas of our business.
- We have offices and teams in many countries, and many roles offer flexibility regarding location. Some positions may also include remote or hybrid work options. Be sure to check the specific details in the job listings on our https://www.kongsberg.com/careers/vacancies/
- Our onboarding process is designed to provide new hires with a seamless and efficient transition into their roles. We equip them with the necessary tools, resources, and information to succeed from day one. In addition to professional development, we place a strong emphasis on fostering a sense of belonging and community, ensuring that our employees feel valued and connected within the organization.
- Your application should include an updated CV/resume and a cover letter explaining why you’re interested in the position and how your skills and experiences make you a great fit. Make sure to tailor your application to the specific role you’re applying for.
- We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salaries, health and wellness programs, flexible work arrangements, opportunities for international assignments, and more. Specific benefits may vary by location and role.
- If you have any questions about the recruitment process or your application, please reach out to the contact person listed on the specific vacancy page you are interested in. They will be able to provide you with the most accurate and relevant information.
  - Global Opportunities: Join a world-leading team committed to innovation in defence and aerospace. At KONGSBERG, you'll collaborate with experts from around the globe and contribute to projects with a worldwide impact.
 
  - Innovation at the Core: Be part of cutting-edge technological advancements that shape the future of defence and aerospace. With KONGSBERG, you'll work on state-of-the-art solutions in a fast-evolving industry.
 
  - Commitment to Sustainability: Contribute to our goal of achieving net-zero emissions by 2050. KONGSBERG is dedicated to creating solutions for a safer and more sustainable world.
- As a supplier to national and international defence and security authorities, we handle sensitive information and technology subject to strict security regulations. To safeguard national security interests and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, our positions require employees to obtain security clearance from national authorities. When starting a role that requires security clearance, the applicant must complete a specific application form from the Norwegian National Security Authority (NSM). KONGSBERG manages the entire process in collaboration with the relevant authorities and provides the necessary guidance and support along the way.

pages.main_text_excerpt:
This is KONGSBERG
KONGSBERG protects people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space. Through innovation, collaboration and determination, we develop technologies and solutions to serve the defence, security and surveillance markets.
About us
We combine military and civilian expertise to drive rapid innovation for defence, research, and commercial applications.
Our defence and security solutions include strike missiles, remote weapon stations, air defence systems, command and control systems and digital remote towers for customers worldwide. Our solutions help strengthen countries' security and defence capabilities.
KONGSBERG also serves the ocean space with technology – from sensors to autonomous systems – to ensure sustainable management of marine resources, monitor climate change and critical infrastructure, and safeguard national security.
KONGSBERG delivers to every part of the space value chain – from launch services and production of small satellites to downloading and managing satellite data.
The company was founded in 1814 in the town of Kongsberg, Norway. Today, we are more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is headquartered in Norway and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The Norwegian government controls about 50.01 percent of the shares in KONGSBERG.
Through innovation and state-of-the-art industrial production, we create jobs and value for our suppliers, partners, customers and owners.
We protect people and planet by innovating technology today, for a better tomorrow.
Three strong divisions
KONGSBERG consists of three divisions:
- Defence Systems
- Missiles & Aerostructures
- Discovery
Defence Systems
This division focuses on land systems, air and coastal defence, naval systems and advanced defence solutions. It includes core defence capabilities such as integrated defence systems, weapon platforms and advanced operational solutions. The division carries significant responsibility for deliveries within highly regulated defence environments and plays a central role in meeting growing demand from NATO and allied markets.
Missiles & Aerostructures
This division brings together missile programmes, aerostructures and maintenance capabilities. It includes both subsonic and supersonic missile programmes, aerostructures production and maintenance of airborne platforms. It also has a dedicated Emerging Business unit to support innovation and new growth areas. The division consolidates advanced manufacturing and programme execution under one structure, strengthening end-to-end accountability across complex value chains.
Discovery
This division integrates the former business area Kongsberg Discovery with Space and Surveillance activities. It combines capabilities in underwater technology, sensors, satellite systems and surveillance, creating a cohesive environment for dual-use and cross-domain innovation. Most civilian-oriented activities are gathered within this division. This allows these businesses to operate with the flexibility required to compete in international civilian markets, without being subject to defence-specific rules and processes that apply elsewhere in the company. At the same time, the division benefits from close collaboration with defence and space activities, strengthening technology development across domains.
Ownership structure
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and is subject to Norwegian securities legislation and stock exchange regulations. The Norwegian state owns 50.004 per cent of the shares in the company.
More about the company
Sustainability and corporate social responsibility
Sustainability and corporate social responsibility are important for KONGSBERG and are an integral part of our strategy. We shall conduct our business in a sustainable and accountable manner, and we must carry out our corporate social responsibility in accordance with the applicable expectations of society. This gives KONGSBERG the necessary ‘licence to operate’ in order to execute our business.
The UN has defined 17 sustainability development goals the world should reach by 2030. Several of these goals can only be achieved through innovation and the sensible application of technology. To KONGSBERG, this involves business opportunities in several markets viewed in the light of our broad technology and skills platform.
KONGSBERG has acceded to the UN Global Compact initiative. We support and respect international human and employee rights such as the UN’s Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child, ILO Core Conventions and the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises. KONGSBERG uses the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines for the voluntary reporting of sustainable development.

Following the demerger and separate listing of Kongsberg Maritime, Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (‘KONGSBERG’) is now dedicated to developing the technology and solutions required to protect people and critical infrastructure – from deep sea to space.
“The decision to separate the two companies was taken with an eye on future market opportunities. To create more value in a rapidly changing world, where security and sustainability are expected to dominate in the coming decades,” said Eivind Reiten, Chair of the Board of KONGSBERG Gruppen ASA.
“KONGSBERG will be better positioned to navigate and grasp opportunities in its markets with a Board of Directors and executive leadership that are solely focused on defence, security and related matters,” said Reiten.
                        
I am proud to lead KONGSBERG into the future, together with more than 7,500 highly skilled and motivated colleagues. Our mission – to protect people and planet – has never been more appropriate and right.
This is why we exist – and why I believe we are positioned to continue to grow.
Eirik Lie, President and Chief Executive Officer of KONGSBERG.
Lie succeeds Geir Håøy, who led KONGSBERG as President and CEO from 2016 till 2026.
“Together, we combine a unique blend of military and civilian expertise to drive rapid innovation for defence, research, and commercial applications. Through innovation and state-of-the-art industrial production, we will continue to create jobs and value for our suppliers, partners, customers and owners,” he added.
A focused technology company
KONGSBERG’s defence and security solutions include strike missiles NSM and JSM, PROTECTOR remote weapon stations and Counter-UAS system, the NASAMS air defence system for customers worldwide. The company also serves the ocean space with advanced technology – from sensors to autonomous systems, including the HUGIN autonomous underwater vehicle – to ensure sustainable management of marine resources, monitor climate change and critical infrastructure, and safeguard national security. KONGSBERG delivers to the whole space value chain – from launch services and production of small satellites to downloading and managing satellite data.
KONGSBERG has three strong divisions: Missiles and Aerostructures, Discovery and Defence Systems.
The company was founded in 1814 in the town of Kongsberg, Norway. Today, KONGSBERG has more than 7,500 employees in about 20 countries. The company is headquartered in Norway and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange.
